character_book.name: Amasia
character_book.description: A world brimming with magic and creatures alike, it’s the home world of anything magical. Elves, dwarfs, dragons, humans all live here. Even mythical creatures resides in this home. In Amasia its residents are larger than average! At current time, the sides of good and evil are at a stand still. Currently seeking out peace for the other side and not wanting anymore bloodshed. The divine beings are always watching and granting few blessings to their selected individuals as even the deities may come down to mingle with the mortals for fun or even pleasure.

entries.name: Elves race
entries.content: Elves very attuned with magic, elves are usually taller than humans but can come in varying sizes, elves mostly refined and regal in manners, most elves are exclusively to their own race for marriage, there is a chance of an elf falling in love with another race, elves has the most affinity for magical uses, elves are known for being reserved and kept isolated in their village, elves are also known to have slim body builds, elves does has the possibility to become a thick curvy body type if their blood is mix with something else, elves are known as the voice of the fairies and spirits as they’re attuned to nature and there surroundings. Few elves are welcome to the idea of polygamy due to them having the longest lifespan and tend to have more than one lover.

entries.name: Dragon race
entries.content: The Dragon race are very prideful, most of a dragon bloodline boast high attack and even defense power both in physical and magical, Dragons are at the top of the food chain, the dragon race are warriors for the goddess of light, most dragons height can comes in various sizes, dragons are normally tall in height standing at a base of 6ft+ in their humanoid form. While their bestial form is known for being much larger at base of 30ft+, the female variations of humanoid dragons are known to have a toned body with massive curves, when a female dragonoid is pregnant her breasts are known to become quite bigger and is able to produce milk, male dragons are known to be aggressive and very dangerous, often with short tempters, a dragon’s word are their law, if a dragon gives a binding vow it must be fulfilled to the end or they’ll get divine punishment, Dragons are quite close with other that are like minded, dragons usually settle arguments by fighting in various types of duel that appropriate for the scene.

entries.name: Human race
entries.content: Humans are known for their inventive creations from both magic and steel machinery, humans comes in different sizes, the human race are usually the average size races but does have some outliers, humans are curious people by nature. Usually wanting to find out how something work, humans have different classes of wealth and social economics, lower classes of people are prone for not trusting and lives in a killed or be killed world, lower classes often lives in slum like areas, middle classes are known for their hard work and getting abused by the upper class, from the middle class are known to be resilient, upper class are the top of the food chain in the human society, upper class humans are known for their increased wealth and land, the upper class are prone to have more magic in their blood which is a clear deciding factor for wealth, few lower class humans are known for magical abilities but it’s rare, humans may act differently most of the time but can come together for a common threat and put aside their differences. Humans are known to mingle and breed with other races often so there’s many sub classes in species that has human DNA in them.

entries.name: Inns
entries.content: Inns are warm places that is run by different races depending on the location, each Inn has its own type of special services and special food type to carter towards their people, most taverns are cheap but their can be some that are of high price that offers a multitude of comfort and pleasure, inns are the location where most travelers and adventurers go to recover. Fighting in taverns are usually forbidden, the owner of a tavern is able to press charges or arrest and perpetrators who starts fight or someone who causes heavy damage to property. Inn owners are usually secretly powerful and strong enough to subdue almost any threat that comes to their tavern.

entries.name: Goblins race
entries.content: Goblins are a misunderstood race that live in the mountains of Va’atsha. Goblins are ruled by the Queen Vrenka. Goblins have the reputation of being evil, dangerous, rapists, thieves, and murderers. Goblins are a race of small green humanoid creatures with sharp teeth and long pointed ears. Goblins are known for being small, in an evolved state, goblins can become bigger and dangerous. some goblins is capable of simple speech but is very illiterate and often speak broken English or a broken form of the language of the race they are nearby. Male goblins are known for being extremely horny and will kidnap and rape, male goblins are mostly a feral, but does have its outliers who don’t condone such actions. some goblins are known to be more civilized and are able to work in different societies, goblins are usually at the bottom of the food chain and will often get bullied by more powerful races. Alone they are weak but together and organized they are a threat to not go unwatched.

entries.name: Dwarf race
entries.content: Dwarves are known for their blacksmith abilities, most dwarves are quite short in height. Dwarfs are a small humanoid usually lives in underground cities, Dwarves are known for living in human cities. Working in jobs that deals with smithing or creation. Dwarves has a high resistance to poison and alcoholic drinks, most dwarves loves to drink all type of exotic drinks. Most dwarves are quite powerful and posses more physical capability than average humans, dwarves are not attuned with magic. They rely on ancient rune magic usually. Rune magic is something akin to regular magic but has more substance and comes from the core of magic. Dwarves do have few magic users in their mix. Dwarves are usually working in a blacksmith shop as the owner making everyday weapons or even mythical items when the correct materials are given, male dwarves are known to have beards even at a young age, female dwarves are known to not have much of any facial hair. Both genders are known for their small pointy ears and strong accent of Scotland.

entries.name: Slave traders
entries.content: Slave traders are menacing people who trade other races even their own to the wealthy, if the price is right slavers will do anything to fulfill a contract, slave traders could be any race of people but is more common for humans to be involved due to greed, enslavers are quiet ruthless and doesn’t adhere to any morals codes, slave traders will do anything to make sure they survive and will even throw comrades under the bus. Most traders are adept in binding and dark magic. They posses the ability to usually seal and hinder great races from using their abilities, slave traders are usually known for going after exotic races such as elves, and beast women. Slave traders do acknowledge their job is illegal but can’t stop at all, it is possible for some slave traders to have some moral grounds and ensure that slaves are treated fairly.

entries.name: Pocket dimensions
entries.content: Pocket dimensions are able to hold items that remains exclusive to the user, pocket dimensions are allowed to preserve items that are hold within, is non sentient. Pocket dimensions will prevent edible things from spoiling. Pocket dimensions are able to hold any type of items or weapons and will grant immediate access as long as the user have enough magic.

entries.name: The Forge [Dwarf City]
entries.content:
The Forge is the home of smithing and blacksmith techniques. It is often referred to as “The Forged” or “The Underground City”, many races who are interested in smithing will go to this location to get their official licenses of approval. The Forge is populated by mainly dwarves and other races interested in blacksmithing. There are 3 main licenses that is given out to its blacksmiths, beginners licenses are for people who are permitted to sell and gives okay weapons, intermediate licenses are for forgers who can take custom requests, expert licenses are people who are given the permission to work with mythical items and above to make magical weapons, the Forge leaders acknowledges that not everyone will get a license but will still try to sell their own forgery of weapons and armor, The Forge is a trusted location as those without a licenses work in the black market or the slums.

[Blacksmiths, mainly over the past 3000 years, have invented various techniques to work the material in different ways. The techniques are performed when the material is hot and malleable and include forging [spreading, drawing down and upsetting], splitting, punching, twisting, bending, dishing, fire welding, heat treating [normalising, annealing, case hardening, hardening and tempering] and joining [rivets, collars and mortise and tenon joints]. All these techniques can be used individually or combined together to create a rich and infinite variety of functional and decorative items. Using the techniques and the heat from the fire the iron becomes malleable and the blacksmith becomes free to do what they like and, more importantly, what the client likes.]

entries.name: Vampires
entries.content: Vampires or as some people refer to them as “People of the night” are quite powerful individuals. Most vampires resides within their own locations and are quite prideful and reserve. Other vampires prowl the streets for weak prey to find supper. Vampires are known to be an enemy of humans, however most nobles don’t bother them much and just wished to be left alone. Vampires possess an innate ability of blood magic and is able to life drain their foes through their claws or even their fangs. Vampires are known for hypnotism and absorbs fears of strength that makes some  species look like a walk in the park. Vampires are superior to the human race in many things but does acknowledges that humans are blessed by the light goddess and light magic are their main weakness. While Vampires don’t burn in the sun they prefer to stay out of direct sunlight since most vampires have terrible skin when expose to sunlight it cause irritation. Nobles within the vampire community are a league in their own, known for being powerhouses and able to even stand toe to toe with dragon warriors.

entries.name: Beastkin
entries.content: Beastkin are characterized by their animal traits, such as ears, the presence of inhuman fur, tail(s), limbs or similar physical attributes. Male beastkin appear to have fur covering their entire body, while females are more human-looking, only have fur over ears and tail. Beastkin can be any number of species ranging from Cats, Dogs, Wolves, Foxes, Bears, Horses, Bears, Birds, etc.

entries.name: Va’ashta [Mountain lands]
entries.content: Va’ashta is the name of a great mountain that is home to goblins. There are rumors of a sleeping god resting at its peak. At the foot of the mountain resides a human settlement named “Vasha” within the mountains depth resides the queen of the goblins of the east side named Vrenka.

entries.name: Vasha [Human Settlement]
entries.content: Vasha is a human city settled at the foot of Va’ashta. It’s a common commercial place where many races mingle and trade here.

entries.name: Gavric’s Hold [Abandoned]
entries.content: Gavric’s hold was once a bustling hub for training next generation of solders. Its nestled in the harsh embrace of the northern lands, known as Gavric's Hold. It was a place where the cold never seemed to seep into the warmth of its people's hearts, despite the relentless winter that encased it in ice and snow. The name Gavric's Hold was derived from the legendary blacksmith, Gavric Ironhand, who forged some of the finest weapons known to Amasia. It was until a rouge dark dragon that lost the blessing of the goddess decided to attack. There wasn’t many survivors as many of the equipment were afflicted by the dragon’s flame. Many weapons were abandoned due to their cursed afflictions and the dangers of having more people go berserk and rampages. It’s currently forbidden to traverse there for all people. Only those with special permission and someone who knows light magic may traverse to explore these ruins. As the strong hold is a place of ruins and cursed beast left to roam in rampage waiting to sink their jaws in their next prey.

entries.name: Magic knights
entries.content: Magic knights are solders blessed in both fighting and magical capabilities. Most magic knights are known to serve the royal capital for some time before getting out into the field. While others are usually adventurers of high ranks, among the knights there are captains who are leagues above their peers. Captains are known to possess great power and be great strategist. Most magic captains lead a small team of 3 but can grow their team into a guild if they wish to do so.

entries.name: Succubus
entries.content: Succubuses are female demons who drains their victims life force. There’s a common misconception that Succubuses are just nyphomaniac with endless desires who just drain sinners through their fluids of semen. In truth a succubus drains men for their magic energy that is quite potent through semen or even blood sucking. Succubuses are known to be dream eaters and enter the dreams of their victims and cause sexual euphoria eats their dream leaving them restless in the morning. If a succubus over extend her victims it can leads to death or leaving the victim as a husk in worst case scenarios. Incubus are male version of succubus. Succubus are known to be possessive over their victims and tends to over drain most of them leaving them weak upon their satisfaction. A few succubus and incubuses works in a brothel getting free magic energy. Outside of their sexual desires, it is possible for these demons to have relationships and friendships with the common folk. Most of them live double lives in order to keep the peace since succubi get such a bad rap.

entries.name: Glaver [Abandoned]
entries.content: Glaver is an abandoned village of harvest used to be known for its artistry and craftsmanship. Glaver is a town west from Vasha. It was a simple village that is a victim of war. Glaver used to be home to many artisans as their craftsmanship is quite unique. Sadly only few villagers remain scattered in multiple different settlements.

entries.name: Frostend [Checkpoint Village]
entries.content: Frostrend, a village that lived near a tundra. Due to the awakening of the demon king the environment is too harsh for a normal people to live there with constant barrage of monsters. It’s also near to Gavric’s Hold and used to served as a checkpoint town. It’s now been repurpose as a small base for adventurers who are equipped for colder climates.

entries.name: Dragon Hunters
entries.content: Dragon hunters are a multitude of different races specialized in hunting dragons. Rouge dragons specifically. Dragon hunters are known to share immense strength like their dragonic counter parts and capable of using magic as well. Dragon slayer magic is invented for harming dragons and break through their defenses. Dragon hunters wield special weapons made for cutting through dragons tough scales, most of their weapons are made through dragon parts. Other times it’s made of a special alloy that’s a secret binding and creation technique of smithing. The dragon hunters do have small hard and hidden villages to reach due to not wanting to be easy to find and also prevent just anyone just walking in. While someone dragon hunters do have moral codes, there are a few that hunts just for the fun of it. Those few are not recognized by the guild and are on a wanted list. Due to being exposed to so many dragconic parts and consuming so many elixirs made from dragons to share the immunity, some dragon hunters go through draconic transformation. In other words turning them into the beast that they swore to destroy. The human hybrids of dragon hunters are quite powerful and feared by many. Hybrid dragon hunters are a rare breed since they keep their humanity and still is able to posses the full power of a dragon.

entries.name: Market place
entries.content: Market places are a place where the common people sell their items and produce, it is known to be quite lively during the day and calm at night. Market places are usually busy during night times of holiday season or great events that are happening, market places can have thieves and other criminals hiding in plain sight so it’s always best to stay on your guard.

entries.name: Liora [Mountain Dragon City]
entries.content:
Liora is the city of dragons. It resides within the northern pat of Amasia where most of the mountains resides. Liora is a vibrant bustling city filled with dragon races and other powerful
Races. It is also known for a city of great warriors. Due to dragons being perceived atop of the food chain, many rugged and challenging adventurers make their way to Liora’s coliseum. The coliseum holds many events for fair fighting between adventurers, the winners are award a jackpot prize and a sacred weapon of their choosing to be crated and soul bound to them. Aside from Liora’s coliseum, this city is known for having such extravagant feasts. While fighting is common, it is quickly settle by having duels within the coliseum. Most prisoners try to fight for their freedom but that’s when Liora’s elites step in and challenge the challenger. Liora has a beautiful city of the sky as it resides within mountain peaks. It’s quite nearly impossible for the average person to get to the city, so there’s transportation provided by the kingdom and other third parties.
 Liora is ruled by its queen Ryoko. Queen Ryoko is beloved by all of her people. She’s a benevolent ruler who seeks the fairness of all races in judgment. It was thanks to Ryoko ambitions and vision that this grand city is as successful as it is today. She named Liora after her mother Loraine, her mother is a powerful dragoness that stood in the heat of battle. She was one of the goddess’s elite fighters. Sadly Loraine didn’t survive with the heroes as she slain many beasts that threatens this world and was able to wound the chaos king enough to allow the heroes to finally achieve victory. Queen Ryoko is a kind person who rules Liora in a time of peace. She makes it possible that discrimination is illegal due to someone’s race. While also making slavery a stricter uphold in her city. Passing a slave acts where slaves must not be treated harshly and must be well accommodated, while also if an owner is seen abusing their slave they will face judgment in court. In her city, slaves are viewed as people not objects that can be molded into their will. Her city may be the city of dragons. But it’s the city that is welcome to all who comes.

entries.name: Brothel
entries.content: Brothels are home to many lustrous demons who are quite lustful. It’s filled with many hookers and prostitution for both male and female to enjoy. Brothel’s are usually mixed in race but each kingdom does have a majority of workers being the race type of the area. Adults with too much money to spend usually come to the Brothel for some sexual pleasures done. Even fetishes are achievable if the price is right. Due to many brothels are populated by succubuses and incubuses that can use transform to become something different from their original form. While the demons do populate most brothels, many other races do work in the brothel as Elves are another high end choice mainly under humans races.

entries.name: Adventurer’s Guild
entries.content: The Adventurer’s Guild is an association of many different races that works to help keep the peace within the lands. Each Guild is assigned a guild master that oversees the building and ensure that training new adventurer’s go smoothly. With each guild there are also there is also the staff that helps the guild master run the facility. It is a requirement for most staff to be at least Rank A or above as an adventurer to ensure they’re able to take down unruly adventurers that may cause trouble. The Adventuring guild purpose is so that the common people can go and travel while also becoming stronger. It doesn’t work like a military for a government but more so as a local militia. S-Rank adventures are duty bound to help their kingdom if there’s a time that they are in need. With the adventurer’s guild there are multiple ranks each skilled adventurer must achieve. At the bottom its Rank E, every adventurer starts here and are sent on mission that doesn’t require combat or anything severe. Next will be Rank D-C in these two ranks, adventurers are permitted take low ranking quests of monster culling and extermination. It proves that the adventurers is combat ready for small scale fights. Ranks B-A, are usually adventurers who are skilled with their weapon and are able to fight well enough on their own while also leading others. Adventurers Rank B are usually avid warriors who honed their skills. These adventurers are able to take intermediate quests solo but is recommended to go as a group. Rank A adventurers are able to take advance requests alone such as fighting Minotaurs or dealing with unruly monsters that poses a threat to humans. Rank A adventurers are similarly able to lead a squad of solders without much worry. It is easily able to compare a Rank A adventurer as a knight captain. Lastly for S Rank, the a adventurer must be a master in their specified field. It must make them easily different from other adventurers in terms of power, intelligence or even abilities. S Rank adventurers are on par with royal guard members strength and even beyond. Upon reaching S rank, the kingdom acknowledges the adventurer and give them some special benefits and bonus rewards. S rank adventurers are in charge of dealing with anomalies and demon ranked quests. Due to the guild wanting to keep casualties low, they instilled this ranking system to ensure no one gets a task that’s out of their league and ends up dying.

entries.name: Demon Lords
entries.content: Demon lords are leaders of demons within their reigon. While Demon lords are the equivalent to a king or queen for other regions, they gained the title of demon lord due to status. A demon lord can have a bloodline, those who are within the demon lord’s bloodline while have enhanced abilities. There are some cases where a demon lord offspring can hold both parents magical powers and create a new and even more powerful hybrid of the bloodline. Demon lords are rulers of their region within the demon plane. The demonic plane is off its own existence though it can be accessed due to rifts within the world of Amasia. While demon lords are usually feared by most humans, mainly due to based on religion and long generational war between the holy church and the ones of the damned. While the title is mainly known for being given to male demons, there are many cases where female demons are given title as well.

entries.name: Rifts
entries.content: Rifts are places where the demonic plane and the mortal place merge. Almost like doors, rifts can teleport anyone across long distances in very short amount of time. Like portals, rifts can pop up anywhere, usually it can appear where magic is heavily dense, while rifts can be used as a portal is highly recommend  to not use rifts. Mainly due to the fact, that using a rift could send someone anywhere or to the demonic plane with no way back home unless trying to find another rift.

entries.name: Demonic Plane
entries.content: The demonic plane is the birth place of all demons. While demons are grown from the sins of humanity, it is possible that demons can be birth from other demonic beings. While the possibility of getting hybrids of races with demon blood aren’t low. Here in the demonic world, it is killed or be killed but over tuned. Power is law in this world. The weak will be crush and the strong remains on top. While it’s more brutal than the mortal realm, there is a living civilization of demons. The demonic realm is ruled by the demon lords of each region. Passage between realms are usually forbidden, but due to the existence of realms it makes it easier to go undetected between realms. Demons who do leave the demonic realm are seen as refugees. As long as the demons don’t cause trouble in the human realm the heroes or races won’t go take actions against the traveling demons.

entries.name: Solaria [Human City]
entries.content: Solaria is a lavish human kingdom, being west from the great mountain of Va’ashta. Solaria is filled with culture of humans including other races. It’s known for being a mixed kingdom where many cultures clash and form. Many races come and flock to the city of Solaria. Solaria is home to one of the central human adventuring guild base. Having multiple districts it’s easy to get lost in the city. It’s recommend to have a guide to explore the city streets so that any unknowing travelers wont end up in the slums. In the entertainment district Solaria has brothels and theaters even casinos for gambling. It’s famed for its ritzy style attracting nobles far and wide to taste the luxury. In the living district, homes are pretty close together. In some instances, a noble person or even middle class can purchase land and stay in the more spaced out areas that are not too cluttered. In the noble district, money can get you almost anything. From lavish living, to the best teachers for learning and more. While Solaria is an amazing city it does have it short comings. Due to being such a large city, it’s hard for everything to be governed and enforced correctly. There is a militant force of the kingdom called Orion. Orion is known for help keeping the peace of Solaria while also working for the people and ensuring their safety.

entries.name: Lugrix [Gaol/Underground city Jail]
entries.content: Lugrix is the underground goal of Solaria. It holds some of the most dangerous criminals that are meant to never see the light of day again. In Lugrix, there’s many layers to this unground prison. The deeper you go the more heinous the criminals are. With the inclusion of tighter security that ranges from seals, magic doors and more. Lugrix is ruled by Misha its fearsome warden. Misha gained the nickname as “the babysitter due to her loving kids and spending time at the orphanage while also having to “babysit” new inmates if they miss behave. Under her rule there haven’t been any breakouts as her power is one to rival even the queen’s strongest. At the entrance of Lugrix lies Midha’s pet named Princess. She’s a rare demonic beast that was tamed by Misha. Anyone who doesn’t belong will be quickly scared away by that titan. Or any escapees that would happen to escape will be force to deal with that walking force of nature.

entries.name: Verglas [Beastkin Settlement]
entries.content: Verglas is within the ice cap of the Northern Hemisphere of Amasia, while it was near to the big destroyed villages and towns, Verglas remained strong. It’s villagers are open to new people, often time Verglas will be a settlement for traveling adventurers. Almost like a checkpoint town. It’s locals are pretty reserved but aren’t shy to meet new people. Due to being raised in a colder climate, Verglas locals are more adopt to colder situations. Making the warmer residents question if they’re even normal at times. While Verglas is mainly a beastkin town, it does have few merchants from the human kingdom who seeks to tap into the untouched wealth of the beastkins.

entries.name: Salris woods [Woodland]
entries.content: Salris woods is just beyond the grand city of Solaria walls. Salris is known to be quite beginner friendly as it only becomes progressively harder the deeper you go. The adventurer’s guild usually send their beginners here. Since the threat level is quite low unless some unlucky adventurer decide to explore deeper in. Within the woods, there are many different beastkin settlements. One of the more common ones that are known are the woodland bears. The Woodland Bears are known for their ferocious strength and very resilient bodies. Being able to tank hits from most dangerous creatures such as drakes, manticores and more! Along with their resistant bodies they’re quite resilient towards many almost all poison and lethal toxins making them a perfect counter to any poisonous and toxic environment they’re in.

entries.name: The Hand of the Forest
entries.content: The Hand of the Forest is a small militia group known for being hellbent on keeping elf blood from mixing with other races. This group is known for being notorious cruel with humans due to how humans had so many twisted fantasies and fetishes. They’re currently located somewhere of the west of Solaria hidden within its great forest. Its commander, Lirael is known for many war crimes committed across countless races that aren’t an elf. While the leader of the hand is currently unknown. Lirael is seen as the face of all operations leading the rouge elves in committed hate crimes against other races. If someone were to spot a member of the group, they are to immediately report the person of suspect towards the nearest local guard or guild member.

entries.name: Amnlune [Elven Kingdom]
entries.content: The kingdom of Amnlune is known for the homeland of most elves. Being a solitary race, Amnlune's citizens, also known as "Lunites" are mostly a reserve race who doesn't often go out of their way to meet or mingle with other races. While there are some racial issues between elves and other races, the kingdom itself is on a neutral ground. Entry to Amnlune is granted by letter of approval from an wandering elf or important offices such as the adventurer's guild, certain kingdom officials and more. Amnlune is currently under the rule of Layla. Known for her divine beauty and tall stature, under Layla's rule Amnlune has been under peaceful ties with other nations ever since. Queen Layla is known for being benevolent and very kind due to her ties with a hero party before her inauguration. Layla is like a second mother to many people, her presence is always warm and welcoming to be around. Her daughter, Sirus however, is more of a dynamic display of character. Sirus is known for being a little of an trouble maker for teasing races and people smaller than her. Within the Kingdom of Amnlune, Sirus is known to be a Chūnibyō. Speaking in hard old english most of the time, Sirus is really the life of the party when she's around. Layla is currently widowed and doesn't plan to find another lover for a long while. Within the Kingdom of Amlune, is the best magic school and archery school within the world of Amasia. Every year it's capital, Aix, serves as a university for many elves to learn and hone their combat skills including knowledge. Aix also has a international program that allows a selected few of students to come to the kingdom of Amnlune to stay within the capital and learn more on their magical studies including the culture. While most elves are neutral on the race issues, there is a group of radicals called, "The Hand of the Forest." The Hand of the Forest is a small militia group known for being hellbent on keeping elf blood from mixing with other races. This group is known for being notorious cruel with humans due to how humans had so many twisted fantasies and fetishes. Queen Layla is aware of the issue and has sent an decree order for the capture and arrest for any individuals associated with "The Hand".

entries.name: Kholtra [Port City]
entries.content:
A major trade hub city, integral to the economy and commerce of Amasia.

The port city of Kholtra sits within a natural harbor, protected by a jutting peninsula. Its urban expanse climbs inland from the docks. Mermaid’s Pearl is built into an eroded cliff-face overlooking the bay, its walls seamlessly blending fortified stone with the natural rock face.

The bustling port boasts numerous piers where ships from across Amasia unload exotic cargo. Near the docks lies Dragon's Rest, a rowdy Adventurers' Guild always teeming with fortune-seekers. The city's heart is its grand town square, featuring a monumental fountain surrounded by high-end boutiques, jewelers, and other luxury establishments.

Near the docks stands The Whispering Tide, a three-story establishment of weathered timber and sea-smoothed stone. The ground floor tavern is always busy, featuring a stage for traveling bards. A door disguised as a wine rack on the first floor leads to The Velvet Veil: a secret, exclusive brothel where demons cater to discerning tastes. 

Notable areas include Azura's Tears, a district famed for its volcanic hot springs, as well as quarters housing apothecaries, blacksmiths, armorers, and various temples. Commerce and opportunity draw diverse peoples from every corner of Amasia to settle within Kholtra's borders.

entries.name: Kholtra's Government
entries.content: Kholtra is governed by the beautiful maiden Mizu. She's a water dragon that is beloved by her people. She even have close relations to the dragon city queen, Ryoko. The duo go way back or so it is believed. Under her rule she has her capable and very strict servant named, "Yamato". Yamato is the general of the Oroshi's forces. Yamato is known for handling civil and non civil cases to keep the peace. The Oroshi's force is a militant group under the direction of the queen and the commander. It is known that the queen is known for teasing Yamato and aims to have him marry her someday. Also with the government is broken into 4 main categories. First is the queen, then its her commander, next is the Oroshi forces and lastly is the Adventurer's Guild.

entries.name: Undyne’s Passage
entries.content: Undyne's passage is a trade route that pass a village of mermaid. While trading with mermaid aren't forbidden it is heavily advised to not lower your guard. As the mermaids are not under Mizu's domain which means its fair game for bandits, trickery, and other deceitful beings with their cunning tactics happening. It is recommended by the adventurer's guild plus the governmental establishment to take escorts when crossing the passage.
